subject: Private deployment: maintenance contingency & version-retention agreement
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment: maintenance contingency & version-retention agreement

Hi James / Elena,

Following our call today, attaching the ops MOP and the proposed version-retention terms for the private VPC upgrade we discussed. High-level ask: coordinate a maintenance window the week of Oct 4 that allows us to perform a non-disruptive upgrade of the control plane and agent bundles with the following guarantees:

- Version pinning: Redwood will pin customer runtime to v1.4 (customer-facing model/runtime API) for a 90-day retention after cutover. This prevents automatic rollforward to experimental builds.
- Emergency rollback: we will hold a warm snapshot and automated rollback playbook that can revert to the pre-upgrade state within 45 minutes in the majority of failure modes (network drain, kernel panic, or KV-store mismatch).
- Maintenance windows: prefer Tue/Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC to align with your low-traffic slice; we can do a narrow window earlier if needed.
- Audit and evidence: audit logs, upgrade diffs, and per-token trace snippets will be provided within 24 hours after the window for compliance.

Requests for you:
1) Confirm the preferred maintenance window (we proposed Oct 6, 02:00-06:00 UTC).
2) Sign the enclosed SLA exception to allow a 48-hour emergency patching authorization during the 90-day pin window (one-time DocuSign).
3) Confirm whether your ops team requires an extended rollback SLA (we described 45 minutes above).

Attachments: MOP_v1.2.pdf (12KB) — preflight checklist and abort criteria; VersionRetention_SLA_terms.docx (8KB).

If the window conflicts with your own release cycle, propose an alternate 4-hour window and we’ll run a dry run prior to cutover.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@acmecloud.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Cruz <ecruz@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance contingency & version-retention agreement

Avery —

Thanks for the clear summary and the MOP. A few points from our side after reviewing with ops/security: 

- Window: Oct 6 02:00-06:00 UTC is OK but we prefer Oct 7 01:00-05:00 UTC to avoid a planned batch job on Oct 6.
- Rollback SLAs: 45 minutes is ambitious for us if the KV-store requires a cross-region reconciliation; can we define a tiered rollback expectation: revert to control-plane-only (stateless) within 30 minutes, full state recovery within 3 hours?
- Audit logs: we need binary evidence and time-synced SHA diffs for the agent bundles. Also request that telemetry slices covering the first 2 hours post-cutover be retained for 90 days for our SOC review.
- Pricing/credits: because this is a customer-driven patch with a 90-day pin (which limits our ability to benefit from subsequent non-critical performance patches), our procurement team wants a one-time service credit for the maintenance window.

Attaching our ACME change-risk assessment.

Could you route this to legal/procurement and security for signoff?

Best,
James Sullivan
Director, Platform Reliability — AcmeCloud
j.sullivan@acmecloud.com
Attachment: ACME_ChangeRisk_Assessment.pdf (24KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance contingency & version-retention agreement

James — thanks for the quick review and the assessment. We're aligned on moving the window to Oct 7 01:00-05:00 UTC (we'll mark Oct 6 as dry-run prep).

On credits: Redwood can offer a one-time service credit equal to 20% of one month's committed capacity for the first 90-day pin. It's standard for changes that materially restrict automatic improvements. I'll follow up with a short amendment we can DocuSign alongside Kimberly's SLA exception.

Kimberly — can you confirm security/audit appetite for the 90-day telemetry retention and the SHA diffs? If we can provide the artifacts within 24 hours (and guarantee 90-day retention), can legal accept the reduced rollback SLA (30 min control-plane / 3 hours full state)?

Appreciate the speed — we'll slot a dry-run on Oct 3 (team scheduling link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcX-priv-upgrade).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment: maintenance contingency & version-retention agreement

James / team —

Security confirms we can meet the telemetry and artifact requests:
- SHA diffs and per-host upgrade manifests will be captured and delivered within 12 hours of cutover.
- Telemetry slices (2-hour post-cutover) will be retained in our secure bucket for 90 days; access will be via a time-limited signed URL for SOC review.
- Rollback SLA: we accept the tiered expectation (control-plane revert <= 30 minutes; full state recovery <= 3 hours) provided the acceptance test run during the dry-run meets the KV reconciliation timebox.

Next steps:
1) Avery / Marissa — please upload the amendment that reflects the 20% one-time credit to the DocuSign envelope and include the SLA exception.
2) James / ACME — please countersign the DocuSign by EOD Sep 14 so we can lock Oct 7 as the confirmed window.
3) Ops dry-run on Oct 3 02:00-03:30 UTC (preflight + abort simulation).

I'll attach a short checklist for security gating post-cutover (will push to the drive folder).

Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
